tldr: 台股在 5 月狂飆逾 5,800 點刷新歷史高後，於 46,000 點附近高檔整理，AI 與半導體權值股續居主導。
台積電重申 2026 年美元營收成長逾三成，定調 AI 為跨資料中心、PC、手機、車用與物聯網的「結構性」而非景氣循環需求。
金管會監理趨嚴：預告修正金控合併資本適足性辦法與防詐遵循事項，並對銀行理專挪用客戶款項案開罰。
台灣央行偏鷹，總裁楊金龍釋出緊縮訊號，但在 1.8% 通膨預估與「匯率升、利率低」基調下，6 月升息機率仍偏低。
美股 6 月 4 日道瓊再創新高，但博通領跌的半導體賣壓拖累那斯達克，資金轉進金融、醫療與零售類股。

items.title_zh: 台股 5 月狂漲後於高檔整理
items.title_en: Taiwan stocks consolidate near record highs after a blistering May
items.summary_zh: 加權指數歷經史上最強段落之一，5 月單月飆漲逾 5,800 點、連創歷史新高，進入 6 月後於 46,000 點附近高檔震盪整理。這波漲勢由外資與自營商買盤帶動，資金高度集中在 AI 相關權值股，半導體與電子龍頭貢獻多數指數動能。市場以「四大驚奇」形容此輪行情，背後是 AI 需求續強、企業獲利動能穩健與全球資金充沛，惟能源價格與地緣政治風險仍在背景醞釀。後續觀察重點在於指數能否守住漲幅、量能是否延續，以及上漲家數能否由 AI 族群擴散至金融與傳產，使盤面結構更健康。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark TAIEX is digesting one of its strongest runs on record, having surged more than 5,800 points in May to set successive all-time highs before settling into high-level consolidation around the 46,000 mark in early June. The advance has been powered by foreign and proprietary buying concentrated in AI-linked large caps, with index heavyweights in semiconductors and electronics doing most of the heavy lifting. Market commentary frames the move as a "four-surprise" rally driven by resilient AI demand, robust earnings momentum and persistent global liquidity, even as energy-price and geopolitical risks linger in the background. Traders are now watching whether the index can hold its gains and whether breadth broadens beyond the AI complex into financials and traditional sectors.

items.title_zh: AI 族群領軍 5 月大漲 5,806 點，券商更新目標價
items.title_en: AI names lead a 5,806-point May melt-up; brokers refresh price targets
items.summary_zh: 市場統計顯示，加權指數光是 5 月就大漲 5,806 點，帶動券商調升一籃子 15 檔 AI 概念股目標價，涵蓋晶圓代工、IC 設計、被動元件與記憶體，包括台積電、聯電、聯發科、國巨與華邦電等。名單凸顯這波行情高度集中於 AI 供應鏈，從先進製程製造延伸至網通與散熱。分析師提醒，相關評價已大幅重估，急漲後「選股重於選市」，類股輪動可能取代齊漲格局；建議聚焦具備 AI 訂單能見度與定價能力的公司，而非單純依動能追逐落後補漲股，以控管追高風險。
items.summary_en: A widely circulated tally noted the TAIEX climbed 5,806 points in May alone, prompting brokerages to lift target prices across a basket of 15 AI-related stocks spanning foundry, IC design, passive components and memory — including TSMC, UMC, MediaTek, Yageo and Winbond. The list underscores how thoroughly the rally has been concentrated in the AI supply chain, from advanced-node manufacturing to networking and cooling. Analysts caution that valuations have re-rated sharply and that selectivity matters more after such a vertical move, with leadership likely to rotate among segments rather than lifting every name uniformly. Investors are being steered toward companies with visible AI order backlogs and pricing power rather than chasing laggards purely on momentum.

items.title_zh: 高股息 ETF 搭上 AI 多頭，散戶參與創高
items.title_en: High-dividend ETFs ride the AI bull as retail participation hits records
items.summary_zh: 台灣 ETF 市場已成為本輪多頭的核心載具，群益台灣精選高息（00919）、國泰股利精選 30（00701）等熱門高股息產品在大盤走強之際吸金亮眼。由於此輪行情集中在兼具配息與 AI 題材的權值股，使得收益型 ETF 同時掌握殖利率與資本利得，對快速擴張的散戶族群更具吸引力。此一趨勢凸顯 ETF 正位於台股多頭與家庭儲蓄轉移的交叉點，把大量散戶資金導入帶動指數上攻的同一批權值龍頭。後續須留意若 AI 類股震盪，集中度偏高的高息 ETF 是否同步放大波動，投資人宜留意成分股集中與淨值波動風險。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's exchange-traded fund market has become a core vehicle for the current bull run, with popular high-yield products such as Capital Taiwan Select High Dividend (00919) and Cathay Dividend Select 30 (00701) drawing strong inflows as the broader market rallies. The structure of the move — heavy in dividend-paying large caps that also carry AI exposure — has let income-oriented ETFs capture both yield and capital gains, reinforcing their appeal to a rapidly expanding base of retail investors. The trend highlights how ETFs now sit at the intersection of Taiwan's equity rally and its household savings shift, channeling everyday money into the same heavyweight names driving the index higher.

items.title_zh: 台積電重申 2026 年營收成長逾三成，定調 AI 為結構性需求
items.title_en: TSMC reaffirms 30%+ 2026 revenue growth, calls AI a structural demand
items.summary_zh: 台積電董事長魏哲家在股東會重申，維持 2026 年以美元計全年營收成長逾 30% 的展望，強調 AI 需求持續升溫，並正從資料中心擴散至 PC、智慧手機、車用與物聯網裝置。經營團隊將 AI 定位為「根本性」、跨年度的長期需求，而非短期景氣循環，預期 AI 相關營收在本十年後段年複合成長率可達近 60%，且資料中心高額資本支出可望延續至 2030 年。魏哲家並提到擬配發每股至少 24 元現金股利。相關談話強化台積電作為全球 AI 建置不可或缺製造基礎的角色，也為市場對先進製程供需的長線樂觀提供支撐。
items.summary_en: At its shareholders' meeting, TSMC Chairman C.C. Wei reiterated the company's guidance for full-year 2026 revenue growth of more than 30% in U.S. dollar terms, stressing that AI demand continues to intensify and is spreading beyond data centers into PCs, smartphones, automotive and IoT devices. Management framed AI not as a short cyclical boom but as a fundamental, multi-year driver, projecting that AI-related revenue could compound at close to 60% annually through the latter part of the decade and that elevated data-center capex should persist toward 2030. Wei also pointed to a proposed cash dividend of at least NT$24 per share. The remarks reinforce TSMC's position as the indispensable manufacturing backbone for the global AI buildout.

items.title_zh: 大摩盤點 2026 AI 半導體，調升代工、散熱、記憶體目標價
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley maps 2026 AI semis, lifts targets on foundry, cooling, memory
items.summary_zh: 摩根士丹利研究報告提出對 2026 年 AI 半導體循環的看法，針對涵蓋晶圓代工、散熱與記憶體的 5 檔個股給出目標價，台積電為核心首選之一。大摩論點聚焦於資料中心擴建放大客製化 AI 加速器、高頻寬記憶體與先進散熱需求，認為供應鏈獲利能見度足以支撐評價進一步上行，即便目前估值已不便宜。此報告呼應賣方普遍共識：台灣 AI 硬體生態系——從先進製程晶圓到網通與散熱——仍是全球 AI 資本支出的主要受惠者。不過急漲後投資人對於哪些次族群風險報酬最佳已轉趨挑剔，後續類股表現可能更分化。
items.summary_en: A Morgan Stanley research note laid out its 2026 view of the AI semiconductor cycle, issuing target prices on five names spanning foundry, thermal-management and memory plays, with TSMC among the core picks. The brokerage's thesis centers on accelerating demand for custom AI accelerators, high-bandwidth memory and advanced cooling as data-center buildouts scale, arguing that the supply chain's earnings visibility justifies further upside despite already-rich valuations. The note feeds into a broader sell-side consensus that Taiwan's AI hardware ecosystem — from leading-edge wafers to networking and heat dissipation — remains the primary beneficiary of global AI capex, even as investors grow more discerning about which sub-segments offer the best risk-reward after a steep rally.

items.title_zh: 台積電被視為 2026 年 AI 熱潮「隱形贏家」
items.title_en: TSMC seen as 2026's "invisible winner" of the AI boom
items.summary_zh: 產業評論愈來愈把台積電視為 AI 循環中安靜卻關鍵的結構性贏家：輝達、超微與蘋果主導晶片設計版面，但這些先進晶片的製造高度仰賴台積電的領先製程。引述的預估顯示，2024 至 2029 年 AI 相關營收年複合成長率可望逼近 60%，2026 年全年營收成長則指引在近 30%。此一觀點對投資人具意義，因為它把晶圓代工定位為相對低波動的 AI 算力需求曝險方式——不必押注單一晶片設計商，而能跨整個加速器生態系掌握價值，無論最終是哪家終端客戶勝出市占。後續仍須留意先進製程擴產節奏與地緣供應鏈風險。
items.summary_en: Industry commentary increasingly casts TSMC as the quiet, structural winner of the AI cycle: while Nvidia, AMD and Apple dominate chip design headlines, the manufacturing of those advanced chips depends overwhelmingly on TSMC's leading-edge nodes. Estimates cited suggest AI-related revenue could grow at a compound annual rate approaching 60% from 2024 through 2029, with full-year 2026 revenue growth guided near 30%. The framing matters for investors because it positions the foundry as a lower-volatility way to gain exposure to AI compute demand than betting on any single chip designer, capturing value across the entire accelerator ecosystem regardless of which end-customer ultimately wins market share.

items.title_zh: 金管會預告金控資本與防詐新規
items.title_en: FSC pre-announces tougher capital and anti-fraud rules for financial holdings
items.summary_zh: 金管會預告修正「金融控股公司合併資本適足性管理辦法」，並同步修正金融機構及虛擬資產服務業者「防制詐欺犯罪危害應遵循事項辦法」。資本面的修正旨在強化集團層級韌性，收緊金控集團跨子公司衡量與維持資本適足的方式；防詐規定則擴大業者偵測與遏止詐騙的義務。兩項措施反映監理機關今年「系統穩定」與「消費者保護」雙主軸，正值台股處於歷史高檔、社會對金融犯罪疑慮升高之際。預告期間，金控與相關業者須檢視內部資本模型與防詐控管流程是否符合新規，並評估對資本配置與法遵成本的影響，後續正式發布後的緩衝與適用時程亦為觀察重點。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission has pre-announced amendments to the rules governing consolidated capital-adequacy management for financial holding companies, alongside revised compliance requirements for institutions and virtual-asset service providers aimed at preventing fraud-related harm. The capital changes are designed to strengthen group-level resilience by tightening how financial holding groups measure and maintain adequacy across subsidiaries, while the anti-fraud rules expand the obligations firms must follow to detect and deter scams. Together the moves reflect the regulator's dual focus this year on systemic stability and consumer protection, as Taiwan's banks operate amid record-high markets and rising public concern over financial crime. Industry players will need to review internal models and controls during the comment period.

items.title_zh: 金管會就理專挪用客戶款項案對銀行開罰
items.title_en: FSC penalizes bank over wealth adviser's misappropriation of client funds
items.summary_zh: 金管會針對台新國際商業銀行前理財專員挪用客戶款項所涉缺失，做出行政處分。此案凸顯財富管理「客戶接觸端」反覆出現的控管漏洞——個別理專經手敏感交易與大額資金，易生道德風險。監理機關多次將理專不當行為列為銀行擴張高資產業務的重要作業與商譽風險，這類裁罰通常伴隨要求強化內部控制、職務分工與交易監控。對整體金融業而言，此舉再次提醒：手續費導向的財管業務快速成長，必須搭配相對應的法遵投入與第一線人員監督，否則個案缺失恐侵蝕客戶信任，並引來更密集的監理檢查與聲譽衝擊。
items.summary_en: The regulator imposed administrative penalties on Taishin International Bank in connection with deficiencies arising from a former wealth-management adviser's misappropriation of client money. The case underscores recurring control gaps at the client-facing layer of wealth management, where individual relationship managers handle sensitive transactions and large balances. Regulators have repeatedly flagged adviser misconduct as a key operational and reputational risk for banks expanding their high-net-worth businesses, and penalties of this kind typically come paired with demands for stronger internal controls, segregation of duties and transaction monitoring. For the sector, the action is a reminder that rapid growth in fee-driven wealth management must be matched by commensurate investment in compliance and supervision of front-line staff.

items.title_zh: 保險業內控及稽核制度實施辦法修正
items.title_en: Insurers face revised internal-control and audit rules
items.summary_zh: 主管機關修正「保險業內部控制及稽核制度實施辦法」，調整保險業者在風險管理、法令遵循與內部稽核所須遵循的架構。此次修正是提升保險業治理標準整體布局的一環，正值產業面對市場波動、利率不確定，以及對商品適合度與銷售行為日益嚴格的檢視。內控要求趨嚴通常意味更嚴謹的董事會層級監督、更清楚的權責歸屬，以及對高風險業務更完整的稽核覆蓋。保險業者須據此調整內部政策、文件與稽核計畫，呼應監理機關以「健全風險文化」作為保障型與儲蓄型業務永續成長前提的立場。後續落地的人力與系統投入，將是觀察法遵成本變化的重點。
items.summary_en: The authorities have amended the Regulations Governing the Implementation of Internal Control and Audit Systems for insurance enterprises, refining the framework that insurers must follow to manage risk, ensure compliance and conduct internal audits. The update is part of a broader push to lift governance standards across the insurance industry as the sector navigates volatile markets, interest-rate uncertainty and intensifying scrutiny of product suitability and sales practices. Strengthened internal-control requirements typically translate into more rigorous board-level oversight, clearer accountability lines and enhanced audit coverage of high-risk activities. Insurers will need to align policies, documentation and audit plans with the revised rules, reinforcing the regulator's emphasis on sound risk culture as a precondition for sustainable growth in the protection and savings businesses.

items.title_zh: 台灣 ETF 受益人數突破 1,855 萬
items.title_en: Taiwan's ETF base balloons past 18.5 million beneficiaries
items.summary_zh: 台灣 ETF 市場人氣爆發，受益人帳戶數由 2020 年底約 168 萬，成長至 2026 年 4 月底約 1,855 萬，五年多增幅超過 11 倍。此一激增反映家庭儲蓄結構性轉向上市基金，尤以高股息與 AI 題材產品為甚，使 ETF 成為國內財富管理的核心支柱。為深化國際連結，台灣證交所 6 月初赴東京參加第 18 屆 S&P DJI 日本 ETF 研討會，與交易所及當地指標資產管理公司會談。對財管顧問而言，散戶 ETF 普及的規模正重塑商品貨架、收費模式，以及與客戶圍繞收益與分散風險的對話，惟須提醒客戶留意高集中度產品在市場震盪時的波動風險與配置適合度。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's ETF market has exploded in popularity, with the number of beneficiary accounts rising from roughly 1.68 million at the end of 2020 to about 18.55 million by the end of April 2026 — more than an elevenfold increase in just over five years. The surge reflects a structural shift in household savings toward listed funds, especially dividend- and AI-themed products, and has turned ETFs into a central pillar of domestic wealth management. To deepen international ties, the Taiwan Stock Exchange sent representatives to Tokyo in early June for the 18th S&P DJI Japan ETF conference, meeting exchanges and leading asset managers. For wealth advisers, the scale of retail ETF adoption is reshaping product shelves, fee models and client conversations around income and diversification.

items.title_zh: 銀行強化私銀分級，高資產客戶爭奪戰升溫
items.title_en: Banks sharpen private-banking tiers as competition for HNW clients intensifies
items.summary_zh: 台灣對高資產與富裕客群的競爭加劇，各銀行重新調整財富管理門檻與權益。星展將頂級私人客戶定位於月均總資產達新台幣 1 億元以上者；台新富裕會員資格則要求往來資產（含台外幣存款、基金、結構型商品、信託、保險）連續 3 個月平均達 100 萬元以上。比較平台已常態化盤點各大銀行門檻、收費與權益，反映財富管理已成為手續費收入的戰略主戰場。隨市場暢旺、客戶資產水位走高，業者轉而在顧問品質、傳承規劃與境外商品取得管道上做出差異化，信託與結構型商品能力日益成為留客關鍵。對客戶而言，慎選與自身需求相符的方案與費率，仍是首要考量。
items.summary_en: Competition for Taiwan's high-net-worth and mass-affluent clients is heating up, with banks recalibrating wealth-management thresholds and perks. DBS positions its top private-client tier for customers with average total assets of NT$100 million or more, while Taishin's affluent membership requires a three-month average relationship balance of at least NT$1 million across deposits, funds, structured products, trusts and insurance. Comparison platforms now routinely benchmark thresholds, fee schedules and benefits across major banks, reflecting how wealth management has become a strategic battleground for fee income. As asset levels climb alongside buoyant markets, providers are differentiating on advisory quality, succession planning and access to offshore products, with trust and structured-product capabilities increasingly central to client retention.

items.title_zh: 2026 遺贈稅免稅額隨物價調整上調
items.title_en: 2026 estate and gift tax thresholds rise with inflation indexing
items.summary_zh: 民國 115 年（2026 年）台灣遺產稅免稅額為新臺幣 1,333 萬元、贈與稅免稅額為 244 萬元，係依物價指數調整免稅額、課稅級距與各項扣除額後的結果。這些數字是高資產家庭全年傳承與贈與規劃的核心，因為免稅額與級距門檻直接影響財產移轉的架構與時點安排。物價連動意味相關額度將隨時間緩步上調，略為擴大跨世代移轉的免稅空間；惟累進級距結構仍使「分年、分階段」規劃較一次性大額移轉更具優勢。實務上，顧問多會將免稅額搭配分年贈與、信託與保險等工具，以優化財富傳承予下一代的稅後效率，並提醒留意配偶剩餘財產差額分配等扣除項目的運用。
items.summary_en: For 2026 (ROC year 115), Taiwan's estate-tax exemption stands at NT$13.33 million and the gift-tax exemption at NT$2.44 million, reflecting inflation-indexed adjustments to exemptions, brackets and deductions. The figures are central to year-round succession and gifting planning for high-net-worth families, since the exemption amounts and bracket thresholds directly shape how transfers are structured and timed. Inflation indexing means these limits drift upward over time, modestly expanding the tax-free room for intergenerational transfers, but the progressive bracket structure still rewards careful, staged planning over lump-sum transfers. Advisers typically pair these thresholds with tools such as gifting cycles, trusts and insurance to optimize the after-tax efficiency of passing wealth to the next generation.

items.title_zh: 遺贈稅修法重塑 2026 家族傳承布局
items.title_en: Estate-and-gift tax overhaul reshapes family succession planning for 2026
items.summary_zh: 專家指出，2026 年起施行的遺產及贈與稅修法幅度可觀，包括更明確的稅負責任歸屬，以及強化、計算更精準的「配偶剩餘財產差額分配請求權」扣除額。修法旨在提升公平性、降低稅負在繼承人間分配的模糊地帶；而精算後的配偶扣除額在許多家庭情境下，可實質壓低應稅遺產。搭配物價連動的免稅額，這波改革同時帶來機會與陷阱：重新檢視遺囑、贈與策略與信託架構的家庭，有望取得可觀節稅效果；沿用舊規劃者則可能多繳稅。實務工作者呼籲客戶儘速更新傳承藍圖以反映新制，並就跨年度贈與、不動產與信託安排尋求專業意見，避免因法規更迭而錯失節稅空間或誤觸申報缺失。
items.summary_en: Analysts highlight significant amendments to the estate-and-gift tax framework taking effect for 2026, including clearer allocation of tax liability and a strengthened, more precisely calculated deduction for a surviving spouse's claim to the difference in remaining marital property. The changes aim to improve fairness and reduce ambiguity in how the tax burden is assigned among heirs, while the refined spousal deduction can materially lower the taxable estate in many family situations. Taken together with inflation-indexed exemptions, the reforms create both opportunities and pitfalls: families that revisit wills, gifting strategies and trust structures stand to capture meaningful tax savings, while those that rely on outdated plans risk overpaying. Practitioners are urging clients to refresh succession blueprints to reflect the new rules.
items.source_name: 自由電子報 地產天下

items.title_zh: 2026 多項物價連動調整帶來綜所稅減負
items.title_en: 2026 brings broad personal-tax relief via inflation adjustments
items.summary_zh: 多項民生導向稅制於 2026 年上路，綜合所得稅免稅額、基本生活費、標準與列舉扣除額、課稅級距及退職所得門檻，均依消費者物價指數向上調整。整體效果是擴大免稅與低稅率區間，降低家庭實質稅負，尤以中所得族群與退休者受惠最明顯。就規劃而言，這些物價連動調整會與贈與、遺產、房地合一等規定交互作用，納稅人宜檢視較高門檻如何改變所得實現與扣除的最佳時點。稅務顧問指出，雖然單項調整幅度有限，但跨多個項目的累積上調，若整合進一致的年度申報策略，仍可帶來有感節稅；建議納稅義務人完整盤點各項扣除資格與申報方式，避免遺漏可用額度。
items.summary_en: A range of livelihood-oriented tax measures have taken effect for 2026, with the comprehensive income-tax exemption, basic living expense, standard and itemized deductions, tax brackets and retirement-income thresholds all adjusted upward in line with the consumer price index. The cumulative effect is to lower effective tax burdens for households, particularly middle-income earners and retirees, by widening the tax-free and lower-rate zones. For planning purposes, the indexed adjustments interact with gift, estate, capital-gains (house-and-land) and other rules, so taxpayers benefit from reviewing how the higher thresholds change optimal timing of income recognition and deductions. Tax advisers note that while individual adjustments are modest, the combined uplift across multiple categories can produce meaningful savings when integrated into a coherent annual filing strategy.

items.title_zh: 台灣央行轉偏鷹，但 6 月升息仍屬低機率
items.title_en: Taiwan's central bank leans hawkish but a June hike stays unlikely
items.summary_zh: 台灣央行轉趨偏鷹，總裁楊金龍釋出緊縮訊號，使市場對 6 月可能升息的揣測升溫，尤其在中東戰事若延長、推升輸入性通膨的情境下。儘管如此，多數經濟學家研判 6 月升息機率偏低：在財政空間支撐下，今年利率料大致維持穩定，而央行「偏向緊縮」的表態，多被解讀為意在錨定通膨預期，而非承諾即將行動。央行已小幅上修 2026 年經濟成長展望，並將通膨預估訂於約 1.8%。此一溝通策略在不預先承諾的前提下，為能源驅動的物價壓力若加劇時保留調整彈性。後續觀察重點為油價走勢、新台幣匯率，以及通膨預期是否出現鬆動。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's central bank has shifted to a more hawkish tone, with Governor Yang Chin-long releasing tightening signals that lifted speculation about a possible June rate increase, particularly if Middle East conflict prolongs and stokes imported inflation. Even so, most economists judge a June hike to be a low-probability outcome: rates are expected to stay broadly stable this year, supported by fiscal space, while the bank's "tilt toward tightening" is read mainly as an effort to anchor inflation expectations rather than a commitment to imminent action. The central bank has nudged its 2026 growth outlook higher and pegged inflation near 1.8%. The messaging keeps optionality open should energy-driven price pressures intensify, without pre-committing to a move.

items.title_zh: 「匯率升、利率低」續為 2026 政策基調
items.title_en: "Strong NTD, low rate" remains the policy keynote for 2026
items.summary_zh: 台灣今年貨幣政策被定調為「新台幣偏升、利率相對偏低」的組合。央行藉由匯率走強壓抑輸入性通膨，使新台幣貶值空間有限，表現可望優於韓元、菲律賓披索與泰銖等區域貨幣。此架構反映一種平衡：一方面維持寬鬆的借貸成本以支撐成長，另一方面以匯率作為抵禦外部（尤其高漲能源成本）價格壓力的緩衝。對出口商與進口商而言，此立場意涵明確——新台幣走強可緩和進口成本通膨，但可能壓抑出口競爭力，使匯率管理成為企業今年下半年營運規劃與避險決策的核心變數。後續仍須留意央行在通膨與成長間的取捨，以及國際資金流向對台幣的影響。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's monetary policy this year has been characterized as oriented toward a firmer New Taiwan dollar paired with relatively low interest rates. By leaning on currency strength to dampen imported inflation, the central bank limits the downside for the NTD, which is expected to outperform regional peers such as the Korean won, Philippine peso and Thai baht. The framework reflects a balancing act: keeping borrowing costs accommodative to support growth while using the exchange rate as a buffer against externally driven price pressures, notably from elevated energy costs. For exporters and importers alike, the stance has clear implications — a stronger NTD eases input-cost inflation but can pressure export competitiveness, making currency management a central variable in corporate planning and hedging decisions through the rest of the year.

items.title_zh: 歐元區通膨升至 3.2%，6 月 ECB 升息浮現
items.title_en: Eurozone inflation jumps to 3.2%, putting a June ECB hike in view
items.summary_zh: 歐元區 5 月通膨由 3.0% 加速至 3.2%，服務類物價尤為突出、勁揚至約 3.5%。通膨再加速使市場將 6 月 11 日歐洲央行（ECB）會議升息 1 碼至 2.25% 的機率推高至近 97%，且多被視為防範能源驅動價格衝擊的「預防性」措施，而非長期緊縮循環的起點。ECB 面臨尷尬的平衡：通膨上升且擴散之際，當初推升物價的油價卻開始回落。升息可展現抗通膨決心；按兵不動則恐讓通膨預期鬆動，使 6 月決策異常微妙。市場後續將緊盯油價走勢與服務通膨黏著度，作為研判 ECB 是否進一步行動的關鍵線索。
items.summary_en: Euro-area inflation accelerated to 3.2% in May from 3.0%, with services prices the standout, climbing sharply to around 3.5%. The reacceleration has pushed markets to price a very high probability — near 97% — of a 25 basis-point ECB rate increase to 2.25% at the June 11 meeting, framed largely as a precaution against the energy-driven price shock rather than the start of a prolonged tightening cycle. The European Central Bank faces an awkward balance: inflation is rising and broadening even as the oil price that helped cause it begins to retreat. A hike would signal resolve on inflation; holding would risk letting expectations drift, making the June decision unusually finely poised.

items.title_zh: 油價震盪、ECB 決議在即，歐股回軟
items.title_en: European stocks slip as oil swings and ECB decision looms
items.summary_zh: 歐股 6 月 3 日轉弱，STOXX 600 約跌 0.1%，德、法股市走低，僅西班牙 IBEX 35 為主要指數中少數上漲者。此前一日，因市場樂觀看待伊朗協議可能取得進展、推動油價走低，Euro Stoxx 50 與 STOXX 600 一度同步上漲近 0.9%。盤勢反覆，反映市場夾在兩股力量之間：油價回落改善通膨展望，對上普遍預期將於 6 月 11 日升息、偏鷹的 ECB。在能源與地緣政治主導情緒下，歐洲指數在央行會議前料將對消息面高度敏感，短線波動恐加大，投資人宜留意油價與政策訊號的交互影響。
items.summary_en: European equities turned softer on June 3, with the STOXX 600 easing around 0.1% as Germany and France traded lower and Spain's IBEX 35 stood out as the lone major gainer. The pullback followed a firmer session a day earlier when both the Euro Stoxx 50 and STOXX 600 had risen close to 0.9% on hopes of progress toward an Iran deal that pushed oil lower. The choppy action reflects a market caught between competing forces: receding oil prices that ease the inflation outlook versus a hawkish-leaning ECB widely expected to raise rates on June 11. With energy and geopolitics driving sentiment, European indices are likely to stay headline-sensitive into the central bank meeting.

items.title_zh: 黃金徘徊約 4,500 美元，避險需求降溫
items.title_en: Gold hovers near $4,500 as Middle East hopes cut into safe-haven demand
items.summary_zh: 金價交投於每盎司約 4,500 美元，因市場樂觀看待中東情勢可能緩解，使美元走弱、油價回落，稍減通膨與升息疑慮，金價單週下跌近 2%。目前金價距 1 月約 5,595 美元的歷史高仍有相當距離——在美伊衝突使聯準會利率預期大幅轉向緊縮後，金價已自高點修正逾兩成。即便如此，黃金在地緣政治風險下仍保有核心避險角色，部分分析師認為，若不確定性延續或貨幣寬鬆最終重啟，第四季金價有機會重返 5,000 美元。短線方向高度取決於伊朗衝突走向與美元強弱。投資人宜將黃金視為長期分散與避險配置的一環，而非短線交易工具。
items.summary_en: Gold traded around $4,500 an ounce as hopes for a Middle East resolution weakened the dollar and pulled oil lower, easing some inflation and rate-hike concerns and leaving bullion down nearly 2% for the week. The metal remains well off its January record of roughly $5,595, having corrected more than 20% after the U.S.-Iran conflict sharply repriced Fed rate expectations toward tightening. Even so, gold retains its role as a core safe-haven hedge amid geopolitical risk, and some analysts continue to eye a push back toward $5,000 in the fourth quarter should instability persist or monetary easing eventually resume. Near-term direction hinges heavily on the trajectory of the Iran conflict and the dollar.

items.title_zh: 伊朗戰事使荷莫茲風險未消，油價維持高檔
items.title_en: Oil stays elevated as Iran war keeps Hormuz risk in focus
items.summary_zh: 自 2 月下旬以來、由美國與以色列主導的對伊朗戰事持續，使荷莫茲海峽供應中斷疑慮不退，原油價格仍處歷史高檔。WTI 與布蘭特原油自衝突爆發以來大幅走高，布蘭特一度逼近每桶 120 美元後回落。能源顧問形容當前處於脆弱的「無戰、無油、無海峽」平衡，警告即便荷莫茲重啟，今年餘下時間至 2027 年油價仍可能維持在約 90–100 美元區間。高檔能源環境是此衝突傳導至全球通膨的關鍵管道，使從台北到法蘭克福的央行決策更趨複雜，市場也對每一次外交轉折高度敏感。後續地緣談判進展與海峽通行狀況，將是油價與通膨走向的核心變數。
items.summary_en: Crude prices remain historically elevated as the U.S.- and Israeli-led war on Iran, ongoing since late February, keeps supply-disruption fears alive around the Strait of Hormuz. Both WTI and Brent have risen sharply since the conflict began, with Brent having peaked near $120 a barrel before pulling back. Energy advisers describe a fragile "no war, no oil, no straits" equilibrium, warning that prices could stay in roughly the $90–$100 range through the rest of the year and into 2027 even if Hormuz reopens. The elevated energy backdrop is a key channel through which the conflict feeds global inflation, complicating central-bank decisions from Taipei to Frankfurt and keeping markets sensitive to every diplomatic twist.

items.title_zh: 道瓊 6 月 4 日再創新高，晶片股輪動拖累那斯達克（2026-06-04）
items.title_en: Dow notches fresh record on June 4 as chip rotation drags the Nasdaq (2026-06-04)
items.summary_zh: 道瓊工業指數大漲約 875 點、漲幅 1.73%，收在約 51,562 點的歷史新高；那斯達克綜合指數則微跌 0.09%，標普 500 上漲 0.41% 至 7,584 點。資金自晶片股輪動轉進非科技類股，聯合健康（UnitedHealth）漲逾 5%、摩根大通漲 3%、沃爾瑪漲近 1%。博通領跌的半導體賣壓，觸發資金撤離 AI 相關個股、轉向防禦與價值類股，使大盤呈現「指數新高、類股分化」的格局。
items.summary_en: The Dow Jones Industrial Average jumped about 875 points, or 1.73%, to a record close near 51,562, while the Nasdaq Composite slipped 0.09% and the S&P 500 rose 0.41% to 7,584. Investors rotated out of chip names into non-tech sectors, with UnitedHealth up more than 5%, JPMorgan up 3% and Walmart nearly 1% higher. A Broadcom-led semiconductor sell-off sparked the move away from AI-linked stocks.

items.title_zh: 博通 AI 營收創高，惟軟體不如預期股價走弱（2026-06-03）
items.title_en: Broadcom posts record AI revenue but stock slips on software miss (2026-06-03)
items.summary_zh: 博通公布會計年度第二季營收約 221.9 億美元、年增 48%，其中 AI 半導體營收達 108 億美元、年增 143%，約占總營收一半，Non-GAAP 每股盈餘 2.44 美元。儘管獲利優於預期，因軟體部門小幅不如預期，盤後股價約跌 3%。展望強勁：第三季營收看約 294 億美元，其中 AI 晶片營收約 160 億美元。財報凸顯 AI 加速器與網通需求強勁，但市場對非 AI 業務的雜訊反應敏感，成為隔日半導體賣壓的導火線之一。
items.summary_en: Broadcom reported fiscal Q2 revenue of about $22.19 billion, up 48% year over year, with AI semiconductor revenue of $10.8 billion surging 143% and making up roughly half of sales. Non-GAAP EPS came in at $2.44. Despite the beat, shares dipped around 3% after hours on a small software-segment shortfall. Guidance was strong: Q3 revenue is seen near $29.4 billion, including about $16 billion of AI chip revenue.

items.title_zh: 半導體賣壓引發類股大輪動（2026-06-04）
items.title_en: Semiconductor sell-off triggers broad sector rotation (2026-06-04)
items.summary_zh: 受博通財報與伊朗戰事疑慮餘波影響，晶片股 6 月 4 日回檔，投資人縮減 AI 曝險，轉進金融、醫療與消費類股。此波輪動凸顯今年漲勢高度集中於半導體，且當指標股稍有不如預期時，市場情緒轉向之快。道瓊受惠於資金轉進價值股而走高，晶片權重高的那斯達克則相對落後，顯示在急漲後，市場對 AI 評價的敏感度升高。後續觀察 AI 供應鏈能否止穩，以及資金是否持續向非科技類股擴散，將牽動大盤結構與輪動節奏。
items.summary_en: A pullback in chip stocks, sparked by Broadcom's results and lingering Iran-war jitters, prompted investors to pare AI exposure and rotate into financials, healthcare and consumer names on June 4. The rotation underscores how concentrated the year's rally has been in semiconductors, and how quickly sentiment can shift when a bellwether disappoints even slightly. While the Dow benefited from the move into value, the chip-heavy Nasdaq lagged, highlighting the market's growing sensitivity to AI valuations after a steep run.

items.title_zh: Quantinuum 完成 16.8 億美元量子運算 IPO 登陸那斯達克（2026-06-04）
items.title_en: Quantinuum debuts on Nasdaq after $1.68 billion quantum-computing IPO (2026-06-04)
items.summary_zh: 霍尼威爾（Honeywell）持股的 Quantinuum 於 6 月 4 日掛牌那斯達克，募資 16.8 億美元，為迄今最大的量子運算 IPO 之一。發行價訂於每股 60 美元、高於行銷區間，開盤跳升至 68 美元，盤中高點 71.35 美元，終場幾乎持平，公司市值約 157 億美元。該公司 2021 年由霍尼威爾量子部門與英國 Cambridge Quantum 合併而成，主打涵蓋硬體、軟體與應用的「全端」量子運算業務。掛牌反映資本市場對量子題材的高度興趣，與 AI 並列為新興運算敘事。
items.summary_en: Honeywell-backed Quantinuum began trading on the Nasdaq on June 4 after raising $1.68 billion in one of the largest quantum-computing IPOs to date. Shares priced at $60 — above the marketed range — and opened at $68, hitting an intraday high of $71.35 before closing little changed, valuing the company near $15.7 billion. Formed in 2021 from Honeywell's quantum unit and Cambridge Quantum, the firm pitches a full-stack quantum business spanning hardware, software and applications.

items.title_zh: 美初領失業金升至 22.5 萬，創 2 月來新高（2026-06-04）
items.title_en: US jobless claims rise to 225,000, highest since February (2026-06-04)
items.summary_zh: 截至 5 月 30 日當週，初領失業金人數升至 22.5 萬，高於前一週 21.2 萬與市場預期 21.5 萬，為今年 2 月伊朗戰事爆發以來最高。續領失業金則微降至 178 萬，顯示裁員仍屬有限、失業者仍能找到工作。數據上升可能受陣亡將士紀念日假期的季節性干擾影響，整體勞動市場仍具韌性。此一略增的就業數據，為市場辯論聯準會下一步政策方向增添變數，也與近期能源驅動的通膨壓力交織，使利率路徑更難研判。
items.summary_en: Initial jobless claims climbed to 225,000 for the week ended May 30, up from 212,000 and above the 215,000 consensus — the highest since February, when the Iran war began. Continuing claims edged lower to 1.78 million, suggesting layoffs remain limited and displaced workers are still finding jobs. The increase may reflect seasonal distortions around Memorial Day, leaving the labor market broadly resilient despite the uptick and feeding into debate over the Fed's next move.

items.title_en: S&P 500 closes above 7,600 for the first time as chip boom rolls on (2026-06-02)
items.summary_zh: 本週稍早，標普 500 首度收在 7,600 點之上，續創新高，半導體領軍的漲勢延續，道瓊亦突破 51,000 點。輝達在發表新款個人電腦處理器後領漲科技股，加上製造業數據樂觀——ISM 製造業指數升至 54——進一步強化偏多氛圍。此一里程碑為 6 月行情強勢開局劃下註腳，隨後市場才在週中轉趨震盪，並出現晶片股輪動賣壓。整體而言，月初行情反映 AI 與半導體仍是推動美股創高的核心引擎。
items.summary_en: Earlier in the week, the S&P 500 finished above 7,600 for the first time, extending records as the semiconductor-led rally continued and the Dow pushed past 51,000. Nvidia helped lead technology higher after unveiling a new processor for personal computers, while upbeat manufacturing data — the ISM index rose to 54 — added to the constructive tone. The milestone capped a strong start to June trading before midweek volatility and the later chip rotation set in.
